title: Diplomatic Disputes Threaten G7 Unity as U.S. Pushes for Revised Narratives
description: The upcoming G7 meeting faces internal disagreements as the U.S. opposes strong language on Russia and sanctions, aiming to focus on diplomacy rather than conflict. This has strained unity among major Western democracies, as they attempt to finalize a coherent statement on Ukraine, Russia, and other global issues.

title: Witkoff's Diplomatic Mission: Bridging U.S.-Russia Relations
description: President Trump’s envoy, Steve Witkoff, is scheduled to visit Moscow to discuss efforts to end the Ukraine war with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Witkoff’s visit marks a continued plan to improve U.S.-Russia ties. A prior meeting led to the release of an American detained in Russia.

title: Intel-sharing pause hurts US leverage with Russia as Ukraine loses ground in Kursk operation
description: The US pause in military aid and sharing intelligence with Ukraine has led Russian forces to step up missile strikes to an intensity rarely seen since the February 2022 invasion.

title: Ukraine Must Cede Territory in Any Peace Deal, Rubio Says
description: The secretary of state, heading to talks with Ukrainian officials in Saudi Arabia, said future talks with Moscow will be needed to determine what Russia is willing to give up to end the war.

title: Rubio says the US wants to hear what concessions Ukraine is willing to make at Saudi meeting
description: The United States wants to hear what concessions Ukraine would be willing to make in negotiations to end the war with Russia, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio said ahead of a high-stakes meeting between the two nations on Tuesday.

title: Ukraine will propose a ceasefire in war with Russia during talks with the U.S.
description: Two senior Ukrainian officials say a Kyiv delegation that will meet with America’s top diplomat in Saudi Arabia will propose a ceasefire with Russia covering the Black Sea and long-range missile strikes.

title: US and Ukraine officials arrive in Saudi Arabia for talks to repair ties
description: First official meeting of two governments since disastrous Trump-Zelenskyy encounter comes as Russia intensifies attacks

title: Ukraine war latest: Russia launches scathing attack on UK; Trump envoy makes disputed intel claim as crunch peace talks to begin
description: Volodymyr Zelenskyy is in Saudi Arabia for his team to hold talks with US officials. Meanwhile, Moscow expels two British diplomats and accuses the UK of being the "main instigator" of global conflict - while a Trump envoy's claim over intel sharing is contradicted by a Ukrainian source.

title: US, Ukraine hold talks in Saudi after Kyiv's massive drone attack on Russia
description: The talks offered President Volodymyr Zelenskyy a chance to mend his ties with Donald Trump after the Oval Office blowout.

title: Ukraine will propose a limited ceasefire during talks with the U.S. in Saudi Arabia, officials say
